_comment: RECONSTRUCTED FIXTURE of a historical failure mode, shaped for the explain-this-operation panel. It is not a captured run artifact. Provenance: Nemotron-H bring-up around PR #412 (commit b9712c383, perf(v8/nemotron): parallelize recurrent prefill topology); the concrete port-name mismatch shape matches the repair recorded in commit 2063aa6b7 (fix(v8): restore Laguna and Nemotron compilation, branch fix/v8-laguna-nemotron-contracts), whose message states that Nemotron declared legacy projection ports and bound quantized providers to FP32 storage. The fault text mirrors the HARD CIRCUIT DATAFLOW FAULT raised by _canonical_graph_slot_overrides in version/v8/scripts/build_ir_v8.py.
title: Nemotron: legacy projection port names fail the circuit dataflow join

stages.detail: Circuit op mamba_in_proj (layer 0) declared graph_slots inputs {x: layer_input} using the legacy x/y port names.

graph_slots ports do not match canonical inputs for op='mamba_in_proj': unmatched=['x'], canonical=['A']. Matmul-class providers expose canonical A (input) / C (output) ports; the single-port x->A remap only applies when the edge is unambiguous, and this binding was not.

port_mismatch.secondary: The same bring-up bound quantized (Q8) projection providers to FP32 storage slots; the repair bound them through the planned main_stream_q8 stream.

Codegen - when compilation fails, start here

guidance: Where to look: the circuit's graph_slots for the failing projection op in version/v8/circuits/nemotron_h.json against the canonical ports the operation interface declares (A/C for matmul-class projections), then the activation stream the slot names resolve to. The historical repair renamed the declared ports to the canonical A/C names and rebound storage to the planned Q8 stream; it did not special-case Nemotron in the compiler. This panel does not propose an automatic fix.
